title: madeup_text caches a network failure of the made-up sibling as a real 404, so soft-404 detection is off for the host for the whole run
goal: factdiff.madeup_text stores None (a real 404) for any status but 200, a network failure (status 0) included, once per host and run, so one failed request turns off soft-404 detection for every source of that host and a gone page that answers 200 is judged changed or moved, not soft-404. A status-0 answer of the made-up sibling is not cached as a 404: it is asked again or held as no answer, as _http_error holds other no-answers. Found by the SP-vdrsfftl review of BG-gx5b2yhu.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, provider as p; n=[0]; p.request=lambda u, **k: n.__setitem__(0, n[0]+1) or ({'status':0,'body':'','headers':{}} if n[0]==1 else {'status':200,'body':'<html>a page</html>','headers':{'content-type':'text/html'}}); f.madeup_text('https://h.example.com/a/b'); f.madeup_text('https://h.example.com/c/d'); sys.exit(0 if n[0]==2 else 1)
